fusions.name: Strand Relay
fusions.desc: Throws a spore that deals 4 damage, then runs along a thread to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles for 70% of that damage each.

fusions.name: Snarl
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of filaments 5 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything caught in it and stuns each for 1.2 seconds, with a 60% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Thorned Weave
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Dense Mycelium
fusions.desc: Every hit you land puts a stack on that enemy, up to 10. At 10 they all burst at once, striking the enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
